name: Dan's Drive-In (Montpelier, ID) Golden Fried Shrimp Poppers Basket (Tartar on Side)
whyItWorks: Shrimp is lean, tender, and provides bioavailable marine protein. Breaded shrimp poppers are bite-sized and chew easily, though deep frying adds fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Shrimp Poppers basket with tartar sauce on the side and a soft dinner roll or fries.
watchOuts: Fried breading can be rich during active digestive flareups
